assets.derivedFrom: Hipparcos, Yale Bright Star Catalog, Gliese
assets.notes: Filtered to V<=6.5 (8920 stars). Fields: unit direction (equatorial J2000), Vmag, B-V, proper motion.

assets.attribution: JPL Solar System Dynamics — DE440 planetary ephemeris
assets.notes: P2. Chebyshev coefficients baked by tools/bake_ephemeris.py for 1950-2099, 13 segments. Sun/Mercury/Venus/Earth/Moon/Mars as true centres (sub-km vs Horizons); Jupiter/Saturn/Uranus/Neptune as system barycentres (centre needs satellite kernels).

assets.attribution: JPL NAIF — Voyager 1 reconstructed + predicted trajectory
assets.notes: P3.5. Baked by tools/bake_voyager.py via SPICE (spiceypy): 1060 samples 1977-2099, barycentric ecliptic-J2000, incl. Jupiter/Saturn flybys. 1.01 AU -> 430 AU.
